messages:
Jules Park: Heads-up from QA: on the compact action bar (dashboard list) the primary button overlap the toast when both are visible on small screens — toast slides in and covers the CTA. Screenshot attached.
Ravi Menon: I can repro on 1366x768 with sidebar collapsed. Looks like toast z-index and bottom offset ignore the action bar safe area.
Sofia Alvarez: The action bar uses a shell-bottom offset `--actionbar-bottom` but toasts are anchored to viewport bottom only. We should unify on `--shell-bottom` so all floating UI respects the same safe area.
Hannah Kim: also noticed the compact action icons are using 28px hit targets. For touch guidelines we should be at least 40px. Visual density is fine if we keep icon size 16px but center it inside a 40px box.
Ravi Menon: current snippet: ```css
.toast-container { position: fixed; bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom); }
.action-bar--compact .btn-icon { width: 28px; height: 28px; }
```
Ravi Menon: Proposal: 1) move toast container to `.app-shell` and use `bottom: calc(var(--shell-bottom) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))`; 2) add token `--button-touch-target: 40px` and apply to icon-only buttons; 3) ensure z-index ordering: modal > toast > action-bar.
design-bot: lint (token-missing-19203): `--button-touch-target` not defined in tokens.yml. Suggest adding to spacing scale.
Sofia Alvarez: Accessibility nit: several icon-only actions missing `aria-label` and the compact action row uses `role=toolbar` but buttons are not in a proper tab order. We should add linter rule to enforce `aria-label` for icon-only and ensure sequential keyboard navigation.
Jules Park: Good. Also the focus ring on icon buttons gets clipped by the action bar container because of `overflow: hidden`. We should set `overflow: visible` for the bar or increase `outline-offset`.
Hannah Kim: I'll own the button/touch-token work and aria-lint. I'll add the token and update the button styles to center the 16px icon inside a 40px hitbox.
Ravi Menon: I'll relocate the toast markup and update bottom calc + z-index. Will run visual diffs. Assigning to @Ravi Menon.
Sofia Alvarez: I'll update the accessibility checklist and add keyboard navigation tests to the PR template.
design-bot: auto-check queued: will re-run after token add and PRs open. (lint-id: spacing-19203)
Jules Park: Please include before/after screenshots for 1366 and 360 widths and a VoiceOver/NVDA check.
Hannah Kim: PR opened: token + button styles + aria-linter. Staging link in PR.
Ravi Menon: PR opened: toast relocation + z-index adjustments. Visual diffs posted.
Sofia Alvarez: Reviewed both PRs, left one comment about not using negative margins for centering.
Jules Park: Spot-checked staging: toasts no longer cover CTA, hit targets feel correct on mobile, focus ring visible. Accessibility tests pass.
Jules Park: Approved and merged both PRs. Closing thread.
